insights.one_liner: Amsterdam proprietary trading house founded in 2015, trading volatility and delta-one strategies; English-language entry roles that mention visas.

culture.text: A proprietary trading firm specialising in volatility arbitrage and delta-one strategies, providing liquidity to markets.
Headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in Miami, Hong Kong and Mumbai, trading on major exchanges in Asia and the US.
Says it values collaboration across teams and offices.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Da Vinci Derivatives, Da Vinci Group and Da Vinci Laboratory Solutions).
All 3 current Amsterdam jobs here don't require Dutch, and 2 of 3 mention visa or relocation support.
Roles draw about 86 LinkedIn applicants on average, so competition is stiff.

growth.text: Founded in 2015 and now trading from four offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

worth_knowing.text: Owned by Da Vinci Investments B.V., a Dutch holding.
